quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): revenue RMB 38.24 billion, up 60.25% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 10.80 billion, up 108.78%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 10.71 billion, up 111.31%; operating cash flow RMB 10.90 billion, up 244.31%. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 6.67 billion, Q2 RMB 8.11 billion, Q3 RMB 10.22 billion, Q4 RMB 13.24 billion; quarterly net profit: Q1 RMB 1.58 billion, Q2 RMB 2.41 billion, Q3 RMB 3.14 billion, Q4 RMB 3.67 billion. quarterly_data.signal: Capacity and volumes (annual report): optical transceiver capacity 2,806 ten-thousand units in 2025 (2,088 ten-thousand units in 2024); output 2,376 ten-thousand units (+54.69%); sales volume 2,109 ten-thousand units (+44.55%); year-end inventory 521 ten-thousand units (+105.12%) - the company attributes the large increases to growth in customer orders. Products (annual report): full 1.6T OSFP224 DR8 and 2xFR4 range on two platforms (EML and silicon photonics) with an 8x200G optical interface; the company says it was first in the industry to launch a 1.6T-DR8 OSFP224 LPO. 800G OSFP comes in 8x100G and 4x200G architectures, and 800G OSFP / QSFP112-DD use EML designs plus silicon-photonics designs for reaches within 10km; main data rates 100G/200G/400G/800G/1.6T.

Company 2026 work plan (annual report): keep raising delivery capacity and shipments of 1.6T, 800G and other high-end products to consolidate its overseas first-mover advantage, revenue and market share; advance its international strategy to fully meet key overseas customers' needs for volume supply from overseas while improving supply-chain stability; increase R&D on 1.6T, 3.2T and faster modules, silicon photonics and coherent technology and next-generation optical interconnect; and expand investment along the upstream and downstream chain.
